newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Credit Bank shares down on media report.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Credit Bank shares down on media report.

text.p: Shares in Nippon Credit Bank Ltd fell on Wednesday morning, hit by a newspaper report that loan guarantees made by the bank for a financially troubled non-bank unit may affect the bank's business, traders said.
The share price was down five yen at 328 yen as of 0113 GMT, below its previous low of 330 yen for this year on relatively heavy volume of 910,000 shares.
A spokesman for Nippon Credit was not immediately available for comment on the report.

The Asahi Shimbun said the bank issued a letter to a financial institution which extended loans of about 240 billion yen to the bank's unit. In the letter, Nippon Credit said it would take responsibility for the unit's management.
Nippon Credit itself extended loans of about 120 billion yen to the unit, the paper said.
The unit's total debts are worth about 1.1 trillion yen and the unit's restructuring has not been smooth, the paper said.
